filmmaker.question: Is my film a good fit for GATHR?
filmmaker.answer: GATHR works best for documentaries, indie features, faith-based films, and specialty content with built-in audiences. If your film has a community that wants to see it together, we can help you reach them.

filmmaker.question: What does it cost to put my film on GATHR?
filmmaker.answer: Nothing upfront. You onboard your film for free and set your own screening fees. GATHR takes a platform fee from transactions, but you don't pay anything until you're earning.

filmmaker.question: What do I need to get started?
filmmaker.answer: Film title, synopsis, poster, trailer link, and a Vimeo or HLS link for the full film. Theatrical screenings also need a DCP. See the full delivery checklist →

filmmaker.question: What are the delivery specs for uploading my film?
filmmaker.answer: You need a 1080p+ Vimeo link (or HLS URL), an SRT subtitle file, a high-res poster, stills, and metadata. Allow 3-5 business days after delivering everything. Read the full delivery guide →

filmmaker.question: How do screenings work?
filmmaker.answer: Three types: Theatrical On Demand (fans request screenings at local theaters), Non-Theatrical (schools, churches, etc. book your film), and VOD (audiences rent directly). You control pricing on all of them.

filmmaker.question: Do I need to give GATHR exclusive rights?
filmmaker.answer: No. GATHR is non-exclusive. You can distribute your film through other channels simultaneously.

filmmaker.question: How do payouts work?
filmmaker.answer: GATHR pays NET 7 — your net payout is processed within 7 days after a completed screening or closed VOD rental, via Bill.com. Read the full payout guide →

host.question: What types of screenings can I host?
host.answer: Theatrical (at a movie theater, risk-free), Non-Theatrical (schools, churches, private venues), or Virtual (online with Zoom Q&A).

host.question: How much does it cost?
host.answer: Each filmmaker sets their own fees. Non-theatrical screenings typically range from $150-$800+ depending on the film and your organization type. You'll see the exact fee when you request a screening. What are the fees? →

host.question: I'm a school/non-profit — do I get a discount?
host.answer: Many filmmakers offer reduced fees for .edu and 501(c)(3) organizations. Select your org type when requesting a screening and the rate shows automatically. Learn more about qualifying →

host.question: What equipment do I need?
host.answer: A laptop, HDMI cable (HDCP-compliant), speakers, and stable internet. The film streams through our secure player — no downloads needed.

host.question: Can I request a specific film?
host.answer: If a film is on GATHR, you can request it directly. If it's not on GATHR yet, let us know — we may be able to connect you with the filmmaker.

host.question: How do I change, reschedule, or cancel my screening?
host.answer: Email support@gathr.com with your event name and the change you need. Most changes are processed within 2 business days. See all the details →

host.question: I'm a 501(c)(3) or .edu — how does tax-exempt pricing work?
host.answer: Select your organization type when requesting a screening. If the filmmaker offers a reduced rate, it appears automatically. Read the full guide →

help.question: I can't access my ticket or VOD
help.answer: Go to gathr.com/watch and enter the email you used to purchase. You can also check your inbox (including spam) for a GATHR confirmation with your access link. Still can't find it? Use the form below.

help.question: My VOD rental isn't playing
help.answer: Make sure your rental window is still active, try Chrome or Firefox in incognito mode, and check your internet connection. If you're trying to watch on a TV, see our TV setup guide.

help.question: How long do I have to watch my VOD rental?
help.answer: Most rentals give you 72 hours from the moment you press play. The clock doesn't start until you actually begin watching. Read the full guide →

help.question: How do I watch on my TV?
help.answer: The easiest way: laptop + HDMI cable + Chrome. Open your rental, go full-screen, done. See all methods (Chromecast, AirPlay, etc.) →

help.question: I need a refund
help.answer: Cancelled events get automatic full refunds. VOD rentals are refundable if you haven't started watching. For ticket purchases, contact us before the event. Email support@gathr.com.

help.question: I'm hosting a screening and need help
help.answer: Check that your HDMI cable is HDCP-compliant, use Chrome, and make sure you're connected to the internet. Check your email for screening access instructions sent before your event.
